# pve_version (Data Source)

Proxmox VE API version details as reported by `GET /version`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Proxmox VE API version details of the responding node.

data "pve_version" "current" {}

output "pve_release" {
  value = data.pve_version.current.release
}

output "pve_manager_version" {
  value = data.pve_version.current.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `console` (String) The default console viewer. One of: `applet`, `vv`, `html5`, `xtermjs`.
- `id` (String) Static identifier for the version data source.
- `release` (String) The current Proxmox VE point release in `x.y` format.
- `repoid` (String) The short git revision from which this version was built.
- `version` (String) The full pve-manager package version of this node.
